COM.note: Satellite imagery is mentioned only for census cartography, not farming.

facts.fact: INSEED has set up a digital cartography laboratory with GIS software including ArcGIS Pro bought with World Bank STATCAP funding to prepare the fifth census (RGPH-5), with a pilot census in 50 enumeration areas (25 Ngazidja, 15 Anjouan, 10 Moheli) and cartographers due in the field in November.

COM.note: Nothing on the national weather service or its satellite data.
